name: MEV Intelligence
description: Real-time MEV intelligence APIs for AI agents and quant systems: liquidation-wave forecasting (oracle deltas + borrower health-factor distribution), searcher leaderboard, builder routing recommendations, and a risk-enriched MEV opportunity feed. Built on top of an L1+L2 (Ethereum + Base) liquidation infrastructure with sub-100ms seen→priced latency. Paid via x402 USDC on Base ($0.10–$0.50 per call), with free preview endpoints for evaluation.
